ideas.title: Raise the reset strength of the anneal's handle-hole cost (reset_strength 2.0 -> 3/4/6)
ideas.mechanism: hcost(j) = 4*kHoleWeight*(x*y + 0.5*reset*min(x,y))/(x+y+reset) with reset = reset_strength*nt[c]. A larger reset term makes the cost of a handle depend less on the product x*y and more on min(x,y) (the minority colour) and lowers the marginal cost of the majority colour; the anneal then places units so that the minority-colour holes per handle are fewer, which is what the request side pays for (head of the wrong colour). The same reset_targets[] feed the Hungarian rematch's hole gradient (main.cpp l.3860, l.4061), so the rematch moves in the same direction. The probe shows the direction: 1.0 is clearly worse, 4.0 is better on both proxies.
ideas.change: solutions/dcomp-combo-dual30/main.cpp l.2686: `static constexpr double reset_strength = 2.0;` -> 3.0 / 4.0 / 6.0 (sweep). Optional second step: the explicit 2.0 in filler_climb (l.3597), the `strength 2.0` passed to rematch_probability (l.10716-10886 calls) and the `2 * demands[c]` in Perforation (l.9877) use the same constant; test them separately, V's probabilities(2.) must stay as is (V was fitted with it).
ideas.evidence: probe4 run group 20261109-093717, 200 seeds, paired by seed: if1-anneal-reset4 dv_best -0.0043 +- 0.0030 (V units), score -0.020 +- 0.072 %; if1-anneal-reset1 dv_best +0.0078 +- 0.0030, score +0.119 +- 0.068 %. Scale of dv_best vs score seen in the same probes: 0.01 V ~ +0.14..+0.21 % (anneal temperature x0.5/x2, run 20261109-093221), 0.003 V ~ +0.042 % (if1-warm46, 20261109-092517). Time unchanged (anneal_end +3 +- 9 ms).
ideas.prior_attempts: kHoleWeight 0.38 and reset 2.0 date from the 11-0x regression (trial_log l.184); V-like per-iteration handle terms (deval-vanneal/vsingle/vtarget2) and deepest-handle weights 1.5-3 (lastw) had no effect or hurt; the reset constant itself has no recorded sweep since the V study (map, open question 4). This is the first direct sweep.
ideas.evaluation: Step 1 (15 min): 3 variants (3.0, 4.0, 6.0) --compare vs dual30, --seeds 0-500, read dv_best paired by seed (SE ~0.002 V) and pick the best; stop if none is below -0.003 V. Step 2: that one variant, normal --compare 2000 seeds (SE 0.026 %); adopt at <= -0.03 % or stack if clearly negative.
ideas.probe: the 500-seed dv_best screen in step 1 (dv_best is the proxy that moved 1.4 SE at 200 seeds; 500 seeds decide the direction)
ideas.probe_result: 200-seed probe run (if1-anneal-reset4 / if1-anneal-reset1 in 20261109-093717): reset4 dv_best -0.0043 +- 0.0030, score -0.020 +- 0.072 %; reset1 +0.0078 +- 0.0030 / +0.119 +- 0.068 %. Only 1.4 SE on the proxy; direction consistent on both proxies.
ideas.risks: 1.4 SE evidence only; the effect may be below the merge floor. Changing the rematch's hole gradient at the same time could offset the anneal gain (test the anneal-only version by keeping reset_targets for the rematch at 2*nt if the joint version fails).

ideas.title: Window search: fewer role-swap proposals (kWindowRate 0.6 -> 0.45) and reinvest the 39 ms saved into iterations
ideas.mechanism: Proposals are 60 % window role swaps (generic<->handle, incl. 1/16 cross moves) and 8 % transfer moves (kind >= 8 of the remaining 40 %; kind < 8 returns false). With kWindowRate 0.45 the gobj after the climb is unchanged (-0.004 +- 0.007) and the number of acceptances is unchanged, but map_end is 39 +- 7 ms earlier: transfer proposals are cheaper to evaluate (fewer pairs change) than role swaps, so the same quality is reached in 9 % less time. In the time-paced final version the saving becomes more window iterations automatically; in fixed-iteration terms it is MAP_ITERS ~490k at equal time. The 2x-iterations relation (-0.052 gobj per doubling, -0.154 %) gives ~-0.006 gobj for +9 % iterations.
ideas.change: main.cpp l.1376 `constexpr double kWindowRate = 0.6;` -> 0.45 (also probe 0.3), and for a fixed-iteration compare l.10649 kMapIters 450000 -> 490000 (equal map time). In final-time-pace nothing else changes (the deadline absorbs the saving).
ideas.evidence: probe4 20261109-093717 (200 seeds, paired): if1-map-wr45 map_end_sec -0.039 +- 0.007 s, gobj_after -0.004 +- 0.007, search_accept -92 +- 58, dv_best +0.001 +- 0.004; if1-map-wr80 gobj +0.014 +- 0.006, map_end +0.014 s (worse both ways). Marginal value of window iterations: trial_log l.588-604 (0.5x 9.905, 1x 9.859, 2x 9.807 gobj), 2x iterations -0.154 % (20261105-064212).
ideas.prior_attempts: kWindowRate was never swept (map, open question 6). Earlier speedups of the window search were output-identical (sparsebits, packed, gather closures); this one changes the move mix, so it is not output-identical and needs the gobj check. Note the caveat from the temperature probes: gobj gains obtained by a colder search did not transfer to score (deval-mapcold 500 seeds +0.008 +- 0.034 %, deval-seven-wide REPORT l.197), whereas gains from more iterations did; this idea is of the second kind.
ideas.evaluation: Step 1: kWindowRate 0.3 and 0.45 with MAP_ITERS scaled to equal map_end (0.45: ~490k), --compare vs dual30 --seeds 0-200, read gobj_after and map_end paired; keep the setting with the lowest gobj at equal time (expect about -0.006). Step 2: normal --compare 2000 seeds of that setting; adopt if negative beyond 2 SE or stack.
ideas.probe: 200-seed gobj_after/map_end_sec probe of wr 0.3 and wr 0.45 x 490k (one compare, ~2 min)
ideas.risks: The gain is only ~0.02 % at the known iteration rate and below the merge floor; the score-level test (2000 seeds, SE 0.026 %) cannot confirm it alone, so it should be stacked with another step. The faster per-iteration time may come with a different search path on Clang (judge) - check map_end on a Clang build too.

ideas.title: Design annealing with 8 segments (restore-to-segment-best and reset refresh twice as often)
ideas.mechanism: anneal() runs kAnnealSegments=4 segments; each segment refreshes reset_targets from the current nt[c] and, at its end, restores the best state of the segment (if1-norestore removed that and lost). Restoring to the best every 1/8 instead of every 1/4 of the schedule rejects more of the late-segment drift at low temperature while keeping the same geometric temperature curve (p0/p1 are fractions of the whole, so the schedule is unchanged); the reset targets also track the column sizes more closely.
ideas.change: main.cpp l.2916 `kAnnealSegments = 4` -> 8; l.2917 default endSegment 4 -> 8; design_papers l.10661 `shared=2` -> 4, the branch call `des->anneal(1e300, int(anneal_iters*branch_scale), shared, 4)` -> `..., shared, 8)`, and `des->reheat_start = shared/4.` -> `shared/8.` (keep 0.5). Check that fixedIterations/kAnnealSegments stays an integer multiple of 256 (the progress is refreshed every 256 iterations).
ideas.evidence: probe2 run group 20261109-092517 (200 seeds, paired): if1-norestore (restore only at the end of anneal()) dv_best +0.0023 +- 0.0030, score +0.089 +- 0.066 %, i.e. the per-segment restore helps. The branch-reheat and temperature axes are at their optimum (probe3/5: x0.5/x2 and each axis +0.06..+0.21 %), so the segment count is the remaining untested schedule parameter (map, open question 5).
ideas.prior_attempts: kAnnealSegments 4 has never been swept (map, open question 5); branching variants (independent quarter anneals, last-segment branching) are about where the branches start, not the restore frequency. astra-design (trial_log l.283) tried 54 move-construction variants without gain, none changed the segment structure.
ideas.evaluation: 200-seed --compare vs dual30 reading dv_best paired (SE ~0.003 V): continue only if dv_best <= -0.003; then normal --compare 2000 seeds (SE 0.026 %). Also try 2 segments as the control of the direction (should be worse like norestore).
ideas.probe: the 200-seed dv_best probe (2 min); also print per-segment best to see how often the restore changes the state
ideas.risks: More frequent restores may reduce exploration at mid temperature; the result could be neutral. refresh_reset twice as often changes the objective mid-way, which can create spurious 'improvements' at the segment boundary.

ideas.title: A 10th design candidate: one more cold refinish from the best assignment
ideas.mechanism: The finishing (filler climb, Hungarian rematch, perforation, late rematch) has luck in it; V picks the best of 9 candidates. The probes show both restart types matter and are not interchangeable: making the two cold refinishes warm costs +0.042 +- 0.022 % (dv_best +0.0030 +- 0.0006, -17 ms), making the two warm ones cold costs +0.040 +- 0.020 % (dv_best +0.0011 +- 0.0004, +19 ms). A third cold refinish (id 9) adds a candidate of the scarcer type; measured -0.0096 +- 0.009 % for +21 ms, i.e. about 0.046 %/100 ms, above the design rate of 0.03 %/100 ms but only just.
ideas.change: main.cpp l.10927-10936: `for(int j=0;j<6;++j)` and `const bool warm=(j%2==1 && j!=5) || j==4;` (exactly solutions/if1-cold10). In final-time-pace the 21 ms must come out of the design budget (the stage shares).
ideas.prior_attempts: dcomp-nine added a 9th warm candidate; a 10th warm candidate gave -0.003..-0.0045 % (Task 11) and was dropped for time; deval-seven-wide 8 -> 10 cold restarts -0.007 % (REPORT, before warm restarts existed). A 10th cold one after the warm series has not been measured before this probe.
ideas.gain_range: 0.005 .. 0.015 % before paying the 21 ms; about 0.003 % net
ideas.evaluation: Score SE on finishing-only changes is small because the designs share everything up to the candidates (0.009 % at 200 seeds): a normal --compare at 500 seeds (SE ~0.006 %) decides; then check end_sec and pay the 21 ms in the final pacer shares.
ideas.risks: Net gain after paying the time is near zero; only worth it as a stacking step with a time saving from elsewhere (e.g. idea map-window-rate-time-neutral). A 2000-seed compare would be needed to confirm the sign at the 0.01 % level.

ideas.title: Window search: colder start temperature (0.05 -> 0.0125, end 0.00125 unchanged)
ideas.mechanism: The window search behaves as a greedy search with forced escapes and tabu; a colder start spends fewer early acceptances on uphill moves and reaches a lower gobj at the same iteration count (gobj_after -0.015 +- 0.006), at +20 ms (more forced escapes and their rebuilds). Whole-schedule x0.5 gives -0.019 +- 0.006 (+11 ms), x0.25 only -0.010, end-only x0.25 nothing: the start temperature is the active axis.
ideas.change: main.cpp l.2489 `return 0.05 * std::pow(0.00125 / 0.05, progress);` -> `0.0125 * std::pow(0.00125 / 0.0125, progress)` (if1-map-startcold) or the x0.5 whole schedule (if1-map-cold, 0.025 -> 0.000625).
ideas.prior_attempts: deval-mapcold (x0.5 whole schedule, on deval-vbranch-o3, 11-07): +0.008 +- 0.034 % at 500 seeds (deval-seven-wide REPORT l.197) - the gobj gain did not show in the score. Pooled with probe1 the x0.5 setting is +0.013 +- 0.031 % against an expectation of -0.057 % from the 3 %/gobj relation, so temperature-derived gobj gains appear not to transfer. The start-only variant is new but shares the mechanism.
ideas.evaluation: Only a normal --compare at 2000 seeds (SE 0.026 %) can decide; no proxy is trusted for this knob. Run it only if evaluation capacity is spare; adopt at <= -0.03 %.
ideas.probe: none left that is informative (gobj moves but does not predict the score for this knob)
ideas.probe_result: see evidence: gobj -0.015 +- 0.006 at +20 ms; score -0.066 +- 0.090 % (200 seeds, not decisive).
ideas.risks: Most likely neutral: the colder search lowers gobj along a component that the design pipeline does not convert into fewer moves (the earlier mapcold result). Lowest priority of the five.

proposals.notes:
Probe runs (all 200 seeds, --compare vs dual30, paired by seed; proxies computed by /tmp/.../scratchpad/paired.py from runs/<run>/err): probe1 20261109-092428 (earlier proposer), probe2 20261109-092517 (earlier proposer), probe3 20261109-093221, probe4 20261109-093717, probe5 20261109-093911. probe3/4 carry an outside-load warning (0.67 / 1.22 cores); the proxies are at fixed iterations and paired, so they are unaffected; the score columns are noisy anyway (SE 0.07-0.09 %).

Calibration found: dv_best (V of the chosen candidate) tracks the score for design changes at roughly 0.01 V ~ 0.14-0.21 % (anneal temperature x0.5: dv +0.0090 +- 0.0030 / score +0.212 +- 0.067 %; x2: +0.0103 / +0.141 %; warm46: +0.0030 +- 0.0006 / +0.042 +- 0.022 %). For finishing-only changes the paired SE of dv_best is 0.0001-0.0006 V and of the score 0.01-0.02 % at 200 seeds, so candidate-schedule variants can be screened very cheaply. gobj_after has paired SE 0.006 at 200 seeds.

Rejected by the probes (do not re-propose):
- Window-search temperature whole-schedule x0.25 (if1-map-cold4: gobj -0.010 +- 0.006, score +0.120 +- 0.080 %), end-only x0.25 (if1-map-endcold: gobj -0.003, -6 ms), stall 128 (gobj -0.020 but +68 ms), stall 512 (gobj +0.030, score +0.18 %), tabu 8 (gobj +0.011, +0.20 %), kWindowRate 0.8 (gobj +0.014, +0.17 %).
- gopt climb x2 (if1-gopt2): gobj_after -0.0124 +- 0.0017 for +90 +- 6 ms - the same marginal rate as the window anneal (-0.052 per doubling of 450k, ~0.015 gobj/100 ms), so shifting iterations between the anneal and the climb gains nothing; dv_best +0.0006 +- 0.0020, score +0.055 +- 0.051 %.
- Design-anneal temperature: x0.5 (+0.212 +- 0.067 %), x2 (+0.141 +- 0.070 %), start-only 1.0 (dv +0.0006 +- 0.0032, score +0.014 +- 0.068 %, -15 ms), start-only 4.0 (+0.059 %), end-only 0.03 (+0.060 %), end-only 0.0075 (+0.104 %). The schedule 2.0 -> 0.015 is at a sharp optimum on both axes.
- Handle-swap rate 150 -> 75 per mille (if1-anneal-mix): dv +0.0011 +- 0.0031, score +0.107 +- 0.066 %.
- reset_strength 1.0: dv +0.0078 +- 0.0030, +0.119 +- 0.068 % (supports the direction of idea 1).
- No restore to the segment best except at the end (if1-norestore): +0.089 +- 0.066 %, dv +0.0023. Reheat on branch 0 (if1-reheat-b0): dv +0.0000 +- 0.0012, score +0.005 +- 0.036 % (neutral, no time change). Cold refinishes 4 and 6 made warm (if1-warm46): +0.042 +- 0.022 % for -17 ms (cold restarts are worth ~0.25 %/100 ms - keep them). Warm 5 and 7 made cold (if1-allcold): +0.040 +- 0.020 % for +19 ms (warm ones are also needed; the mix is at a local optimum).
- If5 (another proposer) shifted iterations between map and anneal at equal time (20261109-092350: map 560k/anneal 8.8M +0.08 %, map 360k/anneal 13.1M +0.06 %, 200 seeds, noise-level, no gain visible in either direction).

Ideas considered without a probe and dropped: V refit (V16 is at the linear limit for its features, trial_log l.1444); successive halving / pre-finish pruning by raw V (dcomp-halving6 +0.002 %); MDP-based within-column initial order (the current DP's gain is 0.13 model units; the stack forgets the initial order within ~50 orders, so <= 0.01 %); restarts from the second-best branch (cold/warm restarts from the best are already near-saturated: 10th warm -0.003..-0.0045 %, 10th cold -0.0096 %); perforation on fewer candidates (warm candidates are nothing but perforation + late rematch, so the stage cannot be pruned without losing them).

Overall assessment for the supervisor: every schedule/temperature/mix knob of the design side probed today sits at an optimum within x2; the only positive-direction signals are reset_strength 4 (1.4 SE on dv_best) and the 39 ms saving of kWindowRate 0.45 at equal gobj. Their expected gains are each about 0.02-0.03 %; a stack of ideas 1 + 2 (+ 4 paid by 2's saving) is the realistic way to reach the 0.03 % floor from this angle. Probe directories: solutions/if1-{map-cold4,map-endcold,map-startcold,gopt2,anneal-cold,anneal-hot,map-wr45,map-wr80,anneal-reset1,anneal-reset4,anneal-mix,anneal-start1,anneal-start4,anneal-end003,anneal-end0075,cold10,allcold}, each with a README naming dual30 as the parent and the one-line change.

ideas.title: gopt climb from the best annealing state and from the best differing elite state (free window-assignment diversity, 1107-02 §4)
ideas.mechanism: 1107-02 §4 says candidates that differ in the window assignment are worth having, but only if the assignment search is not shortened (two half-budget maps lost +0.182%). The window anneal already keeps 8 hashed elite states (l.2171) that are used only for path-relinking. The gopt climb (l.2498-2580, 133k steps, ~83 ms, gobj 9.876 -> 9.849) descends from one start only: the annealing best. Starting a second, shorter climb from the best elite state that differs from the best (elite_differs, l.2172) explores a second basin of gobj for ~28 ms and keeps the better gobj. gobj is causal (direct optimisation keeps its gain, ~3% per unit, trial_log l.575-604), and gobj_after is deterministic, so the go/no-go is measurable without score noise.
ideas.change: assign_windows, section 'Window assignment: elite paths' / the gopt climb at l.2498-2580 of dual30 main.cpp: after the climb from best_mask/best_pol/best_order finishes, pick the elite e (elites[0..7], ready && elite_differs vs the final best) with the lowest recorded cost, restore mask/pol/order from it (same reinitialisation block as l.2505-2525: position, which, hm, counts, pair_state, witness, valid, matching_cost), run the same climb loop for kGoptSteps/3 steps (env GOPT2_STEPS under LOCAL_BENCH), and keep the global best (mask, pol, order, cur). Print `gopt2_used = 0/1`, `gopt2_gain = <gobj improvement>` and the number of windows whose role/edge differs between the two starts. Elite must store order (check the Elite struct at l.2165-2171; if it stores only mask/pol, derive order from them as the final renumbering does at l.2561).
ideas.evidence: run 20261109-003105_dcomp-combo-dual30: gobj_before 9.876 -> gobj_after 9.849 (the climb is worth ~0.08% by the 3%/unit rate); gopt is 8.0% of the design (Task 13 SHARES13); elite stats elite_updates/elite_attempts/elite_accepts are printed per case (l.2591-2593) so the pool is populated. 1107-02 §4 (candidate diversity over window assignments beats V refinement; must not shorten the assignment search).
ideas.prior_attempts: assign-search elite path-relinking (-0.054%, 20261105-113833) uses elites as targets inside the anneal, not as climb starts. map 470k (+0.028%), two half-budget maps (+0.182%, 20261108-104942), tabu-stall release (dcomp-unstall +0.0002%) and map-pool (pool evaluation, worse gobj) are the recorded variants; none restarts the final climb from a second state. Differs: no extra assignment search, only a second start for the cheap climb, judged by gobj.
ideas.evaluation: Stage 1 (go/no-go, no noise): 200 seeds of dual30 vs the variant with fixed iterations; compare the mean gobj_after via observe.py stats (--vs). Go if mean gobj_after drops by >= 0.004 units (~0.012%) and the variant's extra time is <= 30 ms. Stage 2: --compare solutions/dcomp-combo-dual30 solutions/if4-gopt-two-starts --seeds 0-500, then --extend to 2000; adopt at <= -0.03% +- 0.026% or stack with another solid step. If the elite differs in < 2 windows in most cases, stop (near-duplicate pool).
ideas.probe: Implement the second climb with GOPT2_STEPS env; run 200 seeds once; read gopt2_gain mean, the fraction of cases where the second start wins, and the mean window-difference count between the two starts. All deterministic, one run.
ideas.risks: Elite states may be near-duplicates of the best (differ in 1-2 windows), so the second basin is the same basin and gopt2_gain ~ 0. Elite may not store `order`, adding ~20 lines. If GOPT_STEPS is taken from the main climb instead of added, the main climb's depth loss may exceed the gain; add the time (28 ms = ~0.008% of design budget in the final version) rather than splitting.

ideas.title: Choose between the two window assignments (best and best differing elite) by V after a short anneal, then run the full pipeline on the winner
ideas.mechanism: Extension of gopt-two-starts in the direction 1107-02 §4 recommends: a second assignment is only useful if it leads to a different local optimum of the whole design. gobj cannot see columns/fillers; V (deval) can, but only after an anneal. A short anneal (~1M iters, ~35 ms) + cold finish (~30 ms) + V (2.5 ms) on each of the two assignments gives a cheap preview; the assignment with the lower preview V gets the full pipeline. The assignment component of the design-value SD is about sqrt(0.049^2-0.040^2) ~ 0.028 moves/order (full redesign vs independent anneals, map §5.7), so selecting the better of two with correlation rho gains ~0.56*rho*0.028 moves/order (~0.16% * rho) minus the gobj gap of the elite.
ideas.change: design_papers l.10655-10946 of dual30 main.cpp: after assign_windows returns two assignments (needs gopt-two-starts to expose the second: permutation/edge/polarity/A for both), for each: Design::initialize + Design::anneal with ANNEAL_PREVIEW_ITERS (~1M) in 1 segment + finish(extra=1 cold, climb 25k) + value.from_design; pick the assignment with min V; then run the existing shared anneal/branches/9 candidates on it. Print `preview_v0`, `preview_v1`, `preview_pick`. Needs the renumbering (permutation, A rewrite) to be re-applied for the chosen assignment, since assign_windows rewrites A in place (l.2561 region).
ideas.evidence: map §1.5: dv_first 10.086 -> dv_best 10.047 by V among 9 near-duplicate candidates; V captures ~85% of the oracle gain among branches. restart-horizon-model (trial_log l.1335): 4 full restarts selected by a request-processing proxy gain 0.45%/4 designs but cost 3 designs. 1107-02 §4: assignment-level diversity is the surviving solid option if the assignment search is not shortened.
ideas.prior_attempts: two independent half-length anneals +0.042% (20261108-104718), two half-budget maps +0.182% (20261108-104942), successive halving by raw V +0.002%, coarse-select-model (quarter maps, loses). All of these paid for the second candidate by cutting search; here the second assignment is free (elite pool) and only the preview (~135 ms) is paid.
ideas.evaluation: Measurement build first (ignore time): on 200 seeds compute for both assignments the preview V and the final V after the full pipeline; report the within-case correlation of (V1_preview - V0_preview) with (V1_final - V0_final) and how often the elite wins finally. Go only if rho >= 0.4 and the elite wins >= 30% of cases. Then --compare 500 -> 2000 with the preview in the time budget (anneal iterations reduced by the preview cost in the final version, i.e. pay 135 ms ~ 0.04%); adopt only at <= -0.03%.
ideas.probe: The 200-seed measurement build above (one run, over time allowed with --no-record): correlation and win rate. If gopt-two-starts shows near-duplicate elites, skip this idea entirely.
ideas.risks: Preview V after 1M iterations may be dominated by anneal noise, not by the assignment (rho small); then the 135 ms is better spent on map iterations (+0.04%). Complexity of running two assignments through the renumbering; the hand-off (DesignState) must be built from the chosen one only. Not measurable at 200 seeds by score; the correlation probe is the only cheap gate.

ideas.title: Zero end-state value on the last order (horizon handling) - probed, no effect
ideas.mechanism: plan_cost = moves + filler_charge + kEndWeight*adaptive_next_cost + generic_bias for every order r = 0..1023; process() does not know r. On the last order the end state is never used, so returns of fillers, return depths and near-tie choices are paid for a future that does not exist (map of the request side, open question 2). 1107-02 §1 prices previous-product return 0.77 and old-filler return 1.00 moves/order, so up to ~1-2 moves per case looked available.
ideas.change: solutions/if4-horizon/main.cpp (built): Solver::end_scale (l.4575); plan_cost returns moves alone when end_scale <= 0 (l.5249-5250); the evaluate memo stores scaled charge/next_cost (l.7689-7690); tie_choice skipped when end_scale == 0 (l.9438); main sets solver.end_scale = (r + 1 + HORIZON_TAIL >= R) ? 0 : 1 before process(u) (l.11315).
ideas.evidence: Probe run 20261109-093425 (fixed designs of 20261108-224255_dcomp-combo-dual30, 500 seeds x 4 order lists): dual30 10258.97 -> if4-horizon 10258.94 mean over the 4 lists, i.e. -0.03 moves per case = -0.0003%; 47 wins / 448 ties / 5 losses on the first list. The last order's moves are almost entirely forced by the display; the end-state terms change the move count only in rare near-ties.
ideas.prior_attempts: No recorded experiment (grep horizon/最後の注文/R-1 in trial_log: only color-horizon and restart-horizon-model, unrelated). This probe closes the question.
ideas.evaluation: Already measured: -0.0003% on 500 x 4 fixed designs (SE ~0.003%). Not worth implementing; extending to the last k orders cannot help because the one-step model is exact for horizon >= 1 (only the column-MDP's infinite-horizon part is mis-scaled at r = R-2, a fraction of 0.03 moves).
ideas.probe_result: 20261109-093425_dcomp-combo-dual30 / 20261109-093425_if4-horizon: -0.000% (10258.97 -> 10258.94 over 4 lists; 47/448/5 on list 1). Closed: do not implement.
ideas.risks: None (closed). Recorded here so the supervisor can strike open question 2 of the request map.

proposals.notes:
Summary: the three outside sources contain no untried component that fits 2.5 h and ≥ 0.03 %. Component-by-component check:

gpt6pro-advice-1107-02.md
- §2 first candidate (general 602-pattern printing of generic windows, protect only a 5-edge tree, joint design of pairs/evidence order/printing): research-level by the advice's own gate (0.15 moves/order model gain before investing); dual30 requires a complete comparator for helpers, look-ahead and PosetSums (M=6).
